Your Privacy Preferences

We use Essential and Non-Essential cookies on our site. Non-Essential cookies are optional and can be turned OFF for this site, but Essential cookies are important for our site to function properly and cannot be turned off below. So, VEG and others may collect IP address and other information about you when you visit our site, even if you turn OFF all Non-Essential cookies. You can learn more about Essential and Non-Essential cookies on our site below.

Opt-Out of Sales, Sharing and Targeted Advertising. We may use and disclose certain information about you for targeted advertising and similar purposes, including via cookies and other automated technologies on this site and by other ‘offsite’ means. Doing so may be considered “sales,” “sharing” or “targeted advertising” and some privacy laws give consumers the right to opt out of such uses and disclosures. To opt out of all sales, sharing and targeted advertising by VEG, please take both steps below:

Browser Opt-Out: To opt out of Targeting and other Non-Essential cookies on our site, click “Essential Cookies Only” below or turn on Global Privacy Control—or “GPC”—signals for your browser (learn more about GPC here). If your browser is transmitting a GPC signal when you visit our site, or you click “Essential Cookies Only” below, Targeting and other Non-Essential cookies will be turned off on this site. Please note that your preferences are browser and device specific. So, you should turn on GPC or set Essential Cookies Only for each browser and device you use to access this site.


Offsite Opt-Out: To opt out of offsite sales, sharing and targeted advertising by VEG, please submit a Request to Opt Out of Targeted Advertising / Sales and Sharing here.
